name: YS LeadGen – Popup Builder, Forms & Lead Generation to Capture Leads, Grow Subscribers & Boost Sales
author: YS Innovations

sections.description:
YS LeadGen is a powerful popup and form builder designed to help businesses capture more leads, grow email subscribers, promote offers, and improve conversions without writing code.

Whether you run a business website, blog, online store, agency, or landing page, YS LeadGen gives you everything you need to create professional campaigns directly inside your WordPress dashboard.

Create beautiful popups, embedded forms, floating bars, slide-ins, welcome screens, surveys, coupon campaigns, and more using an intuitive drag-and-drop builder. Display them based on visitor behavior, page conditions, or custom rules to reach the right audience at the right time.

Unlike many hosted solutions, YS LeadGen works entirely inside WordPress, giving you full control over your campaigns and your data.

Quick Links

  • Live Demo
  • Documentation
  • Templates
  • Pricing

Why Choose YS LeadGen?

YS LeadGen combines popup creation, lead generation, visitor engagement, and campaign management into a single plugin.

Easy Visual Builder

Design professional campaigns using an intuitive drag-and-drop editor. Customize layouts, colors, typography, buttons, images, spacing, and form fields without touching code.

Multiple Campaign Types

Choose from a variety of popup styles and lead capture forms suitable for marketing campaigns, newsletters, promotions, announcements, customer feedback, product recommendations, and more.

Smart Display Rules

Show campaigns based on visitor behavior, browsing activity, page location, referral source, device type, schedule, or other targeting conditions.

Built for Performance

Campaign assets load only when required, helping minimize unnecessary resource loading and maintain fast page performance.

Works with Your Favorite Tools

Integrate with popular email marketing platforms and WordPress page builders to fit naturally into your existing workflow.

Your Data Stays Yours

Campaigns, reports, and lead information are stored inside your own WordPress installation. You decide if and when data should be shared with third-party services through optional integrations.

Features

YS LeadGen provides a complete toolkit for building high-converting lead generation campaigns.

Popup Builder

  • Visual drag-and-drop editor
  • Responsive popup designs
  • Ready-made templates
  • Create campaigns without coding
  • Real-time preview
  • Custom colors, fonts, spacing, and layouts
  • Multi-step campaign support
  • Reusable design elements

Form Builder

  • Email signup forms
  • Contact forms
  • Lead generation forms
  • Newsletter subscription forms
  • Survey forms
  • Feedback forms
  • Custom fields
  • GDPR consent checkbox
  • Google reCAPTCHA support

Display Triggers

  • Exit Intent
  • Page Load
  • Time Delay
  • Scroll Percentage
  • Click Trigger
  • Inactivity Detection
  • Manual Trigger
  • Custom Trigger Support

Targeting Options

  • Specific pages and posts
  • Categories and tags
  • Visitor devices
  • New and returning visitors
  • Referral source
  • Traffic source
  • Scheduling
  • Frequency control
  • Cookie-based targeting
  • WooCommerce targeting

Analytics

Track campaign performance using built-in reporting.

Monitor:

  • Views
  • Conversions
  • Conversion rate
  • Device performance
  • Campaign performance
  • Revenue attribution (WooCommerce)

Activity Logs

Review a timeline of form submissions and integration activity for each form campaign.

  • Form submit success and failure events
  • reCAPTCHA verification results
  • Consent and validation outcomes
  • Email marketing and CRM sync results
  • Webhook delivery status
  • Search, filter by status or component, and paginate logs

WooCommerce Features

Create campaigns designed specifically for online stores.

Examples include:

  • Coupon popups
  • Checkout offers
  • Cart abandonment campaigns
  • Product recommendations
  • Upsell campaigns
  • Cross-sell campaigns
  • Product-specific campaigns
  • Category targeting

Integrations

Connect YS LeadGen with popular marketing platforms.

Supported integrations include:

  • Mailchimp
  • HubSpot
  • Omnisend
  • GetResponse
  • Drip
  • Brevo
  • Klaviyo
  • ActiveCampaign
  • Kit (ConvertKit)
  • MailerLite
  • Webhooks

Popup & Form Types

Choose the campaign style that best fits your marketing goal.

Standard Popups

Display attractive popups to promote offers, announcements, newsletters, or lead capture campaigns.

Exit Intent Popups

Show a popup when visitors indicate they are about to leave your website, helping reduce lost opportunities.

Lightbox Popups

Display content prominently in the center of the page to increase visibility and engagement.

Floating Bars

Create announcement bars that appear at the top or bottom of the screen without interrupting browsing.

Slide-In Popups

Display campaigns that smoothly slide into view from the corner of the page.

Fullscreen Welcome Screens

Create immersive welcome messages, promotions, or seasonal campaigns.

Coupon Campaigns

Offer discount codes and promotional offers to encourage conversions.

Countdown Campaigns

Create urgency using countdown timers for limited-time promotions and events.

Spin-to-Win Campaigns

Increase engagement with interactive spin wheel campaigns that reward visitors with coupons or special offers.

Yes / No Campaigns

Guide visitors through simple decision-based interactions before displaying offers.

Inline Forms

Embed lead capture forms directly inside posts, pages, or landing page content.

Embedded Forms

Place forms anywhere using shortcodes or supported page builders.

Survey & NPS Forms

Collect customer feedback, satisfaction scores, and survey responses.

Social Proof Campaigns

Display notifications that showcase customer activity and build visitor confidence.

Video Popups

Present YouTube, Vimeo, or self-hosted videos inside engaging popup campaigns.

Content Lockers

Restrict selected content until visitors complete an action such as subscribing or submitting a form.

Age Verification

Verify visitor eligibility before displaying restricted content.

Cookie Consent

Display cookie consent notices to help support privacy compliance.

Display Rules & Targeting

Show campaigns only when they are most relevant to your visitors. YS LeadGen includes flexible display conditions to help improve engagement while reducing unnecessary interruptions.

Page Targeting

Choose where your campaigns appear.

  • Entire website
  • Homepage
  • Individual pages
  • Blog posts
  • Categories
  • Tags
  • Custom post types
  • Search results
  • 404 pages

  • New visitors
  • Returning visitors
  • Logged-in users
  • Logged-out visitors
  • User roles
  • Visitor device
  • Browser type
  • Language
  • Referring website
  • UTM campaign parameters

Launch campaigns based on how visitors interact with your website.

  • Exit Intent
  • Time Delay
  • Scroll Depth
  • Click Events
  • Page Views
  • Session Duration
  • Inactivity Detection
  • Manual Trigger
  • Custom Events

Scheduling

Control exactly when campaigns become active.

  • Start and end dates
  • Time-based scheduling
  • Recurring campaigns
  • Holiday promotions
  • Flash sales
  • Product launches

Frequency Control

Prevent visitors from seeing the same campaign too often.

  • Show once per session
  • Show once per visitor
  • Delay redisplaying campaigns
  • Cookie-based frequency limits

  • Cart abandonment campaigns

  • Cross-sell campaigns

  • Limited-time offers
  • Product launch campaigns
  • Seasonal promotions

  • Feedback form
  • Registration form

  • Custom validation
  • Email notifications

Analytics & Reports

Understand how your campaigns perform using built-in reporting.

Track important metrics including:

  • Campaign views
  • Form submissions
  • Conversion rate

  • Traffic performance
  • Revenue attribution (WooCommerce)
  • Campaign history

Activity Logs

Each form campaign includes an Activity Logs timeline so you can troubleshoot submissions and integrations in one place.

Track events such as:

  • Form submit success and failures
  • reCAPTCHA verification outcomes
  • Consent and validation results
  • Email marketing and CRM sync success or failure
  • Webhook delivery status

Reports help identify which campaigns generate the best results so you can continue improving your marketing efforts.

Advanced analytics and extended reporting are available in premium plans.

Email Marketing Integrations

Automatically send captured leads to your preferred email marketing platform.

Supported integrations include:

  • Mailchimp
  • HubSpot
  • Omnisend
  • GetResponse
  • Drip
  • Brevo
  • Klaviyo

Works With

YS LeadGen is designed to work alongside popular WordPress plugins and page builders.

  • Gutenberg
  • Elementor

  • Polylang

Performance

YS LeadGen is designed with performance in mind.

  • Responsive layouts
  • Optimized frontend scripts
  • Compatible with most caching plugins
  • Compatible with CDN services
  • Works with modern WordPress themes

Performance can vary depending on your website configuration, hosting environment, and the number of active campaigns.

Accessibility

YS LeadGen is built to support accessible user experiences.

Features include:

  • Keyboard navigation support
  • Accessible form labels
  • Focus management
  • Screen reader friendly markup
  • Responsive layouts
  • Mobile-friendly interfaces

Accessibility improvements continue with every release.

Privacy

Your website data remains under your control.

YS LeadGen stores campaign settings, reports, and lead information within your own WordPress installation.

Data is only shared with third-party services when you enable an integration.

Supported integrations follow their own privacy policies.

The plugin does not send data to YS Innovations servers.

Free & Premium

The free version provides everything you need to begin creating lead generation campaigns.

Free Version

  • Drag-and-drop builder
  • Core popup types
  • Basic forms
  • Basic triggers
  • Basic targeting
  • Limited templates
  • Basic analytics
  • Activity Logs for form submissions
  • Community support

Premium Version

Premium plans add additional capabilities such as:

  • Unlimited campaigns
  • Premium templates
  • Advanced targeting
  • Advanced triggers
  • WooCommerce enhancements
  • Team Collaboration

  • Advanced analytics
  • Lead export
  • Priority support
  • Additional integrations

Visit Pricing for the latest plan comparison.

Developer Friendly

YS LeadGen is designed to fit into existing WordPress workflows.

Developer features include:

  • WordPress coding standards
  • Translation ready
  • Localization support
  • Shortcode support
  • Block support
  • Action hooks
  • Filter hooks
  • Clean database structure
  • Extensible architecture

Developer documentation is available at docs.ysleadgen.com.

Support

Need help?

Resources available include:

  • Documentation
  • Frequently Asked Questions
  • WordPress.org Support Forum
  • Feature Requests
  • Bug Reports
  • Website

Privacy Policy

YS LeadGen stores campaign settings, popup configurations, reports, and lead information inside your WordPress website.

The plugin does not send data to YS Innovations servers.

When you enable an integration such as Mailchimp, HubSpot, Omnisend, GetResponse, Drip, Brevo, Klaviyo, ActiveCampaign, Kit, MailerLite, or Webhooks, only the information required by that service is transmitted according to its own privacy policy.

Depending on how you configure your campaigns, the plugin may store:

  • Form submissions
  • Email addresses
  • Contact information
  • Campaign statistics
  • Activity log events for form submissions and integrations
  • Cookies used for display frequency
  • Visitor preferences

Website owners are responsible for configuring their privacy policy and consent notices in accordance with applicable privacy regulations.

Full Privacy Policy: Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  3. Search for YS LeadGen.
  4. Click Install Now.
  5. Click Activate.
  6. Open LeadGen from the WordPress admin menu.
  7. Create your first campaign using the visual builder.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the ZIP file.
  4. Click Install Now.
  5. Activate the plugin.
  6. Open LeadGen from the WordPress dashboard.

Getting Started

  1. Create a new campaign.
  2. Choose a popup or form template.
  3. Customize the design.
  4. Configure display triggers and targeting.
  5. Connect your email marketing service (optional).
  6. Publish the campaign.
  7. Monitor results from the Analytics section.
sections.faq:
Is YS LeadGen free?

Yes. The free version includes the visual builder, essential popup types, basic forms, targeting options, analytics, and community support. Premium plans unlock additional templates, advanced targeting, WooCommerce features, integrations, and more.

Do I need coding knowledge?

No. Campaigns can be created using the drag-and-drop builder without writing code.

Where are my leads stored?

Leads and campaign data are stored within your WordPress website. Data is only sent to third-party services when you enable an integration.

Can I export my leads?

Lead export is available in premium plans.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. YS LeadGen includes campaigns designed specifically for WooCommerce stores, including coupon campaigns, checkout promotions, product recommendations, and cart recovery features.

Does it work with Elementor?

Yes. The plugin is compatible with Elementor and other popular page builders.

Which page builders are supported?

YS LeadGen works with:

  • Gutenberg
  • Elementor
  • Divi
  • Beaver Builder
  • Bricks Builder

Is the plugin mobile friendly?

Yes. All campaigns are responsive and designed to work across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Does it support multilingual websites?

Yes. The plugin works with WPML, Polylang, and WordPress translation tools.

Does it support Google reCAPTCHA?

Yes. Google reCAPTCHA can be enabled to help reduce spam submissions.

Can I schedule campaigns?

Yes. Campaigns can be scheduled using start and end dates.

Can I show different campaigns on different pages?

Yes. Display rules allow campaigns to appear only on selected pages, posts, categories, or other locations.

Is YS LeadGen compatible with caching plugins?

Yes. The plugin is designed to work with most WordPress caching plugins and CDN services.

Does the plugin affect website performance?

YS LeadGen loads campaign assets only when required. Overall performance depends on your website configuration, hosting environment, and active campaigns.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes. YS LeadGen follows WordPress localization standards and can be translated into multiple languages.

How can I get support?

Free users can use the WordPress.org support forum.

Premium customers receive priority support.

Documentation is available at docs.ysleadgen.com.

Privacy Policy

YS LeadGen stores campaign settings, popup configurations, reports, and lead information inside your WordPress website.

The plugin does not send data to YS Innovations servers.

When you enable an integration such as Mailchimp, HubSpot, Omnisend, GetResponse, Drip, Brevo, Klaviyo, ActiveCampaign, Kit, MailerLite, or Webhooks, only the information required by that service is transmitted according to its own privacy policy.

Depending on how you configure your campaigns, the plugin may store:

  • Form submissions
  • Email addresses
  • Contact information
  • Campaign statistics
  • Activity log events for form submissions and integrations
  • Cookies used for display frequency
  • Visitor preferences

Website owners are responsible for configuring their privacy policy and consent notices in accordance with applicable privacy regulations.
